shots.focal_element: Headline 'AI Workspace' stacked above a full ClickUp Home/Inbox window on a grainy gradient background
shots.transition_other: UI window rises into frame from below while the headline fades/scales in (continues the previous camera move; exact mechanism not visible at 2 fps)
shots.typography: Large white geometric sans headline, semi-bold, title case, tight tracking; UI copy is the product's own small sans text (not quoted). Font guess (low confidence): a grotesk like Plus Jakarta Sans.
shots.what_happens: Lands the VO line 'into one AI workspace' (w56-w60): the headline fades in over the gradient as the ClickUp Inbox window settles below it; by ~35.0 s the camera pushes/tilts toward the window with heavy motion blur, cutting away on the move.
shots.build_rebuild: Over an animated grain gradient, fade+scale a centered white headline in the top third while a screenshot of the app window (rounded corners, drop shadow) translates up from the bottom edge, then tween the window's scale up and rotateX a few degrees with motion blur in the last 0.4 s.

shots.focal_element: Centered phrase 'Designed with' on the grainy pink-orange-blue gradient
shots.typography: White geometric sans, semi-bold, sentence case, tight tracking, medium size; same family as the 'AI Workspace' headline.
shots.what_happens: Text-only beat synced to VO 'Designed with' (w61-w62); by 36.0 s the text is gone and a heavily motion-blurred, tilted UI window sweeps in from the lower right.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard cut to the gradient background with the phrase centered, hold ~0.4 s, then remove the text and fly a tilted app screenshot in from the bottom-right with strong directional motion blur.

shots.composition_other: Tilted UI panel cropped into the lower-right corner, gradient filling the rest
shots.focal_element: Motion-blurred, perspective-tilted ClickUp window entering from the lower right
shots.what_happens: A two-frame (66 ms) transitional sliver: the tilted app window streaks in with heavy motion blur, bridging 'Designed with' and 'pixel precision'. Only one keyframe is available, so no motion within the shot can be seen.
shots.build_rebuild: Render 2 frames of the app window in 3D perspective (rotateX/rotateZ tilt) translating up-left from the bottom-right corner with a strong motion-blur filter, used as the whip into the next shot.

shots.focal_element: The 'Mango Tech' workspace switcher, called out with a dotted leader line to the label 'pixel precision'
shots.transition_other: Whip-style landing of the blurred tilted window from s014 into a sharp, perspective-tilted UI close-up
shots.typography: Large lowercase geometric sans, semi-bold, tight tracking, white at partial opacity (soft, slightly glowing); connected to the UI by a thin dotted callout line.
shots.what_happens: Synced to 'pixel precision' (w63-w64): the camera drifts slowly over a tilted UI close-up (sidebar, Home/Inbox, Marketing list) with shallow depth of field, while the callout label slides left and partly off-frame by 37.5 s.
shots.build_rebuild: Place the app screenshot in a 3D plane (rotateX ~15deg, rotateZ ~-8deg) with a depth-of-field blur away from the top-left, add a dotted SVG leader from the workspace switcher to a lowercase label, and slowly pan the camera right-to-left over 1.5 s.

shots.focal_element: Centered dark kinetic phrases on a near-white background with a lavender top haze, ending in a segmented donut chart
shots.typography: Dark navy geometric sans, semi-bold, sentence case, tight tracking; the word stack (context/collaboration/visibility/productivity) is lighter lavender and fades by row; donut centre label is small bold 'A New Era of' over a larger bold 'Productivity'; chart numbers bold white/black.
shots.what_happens: Fast kinetic sequence following the VO (w65-w76): 'Convergence unlocks' types/wipes on, 'Maximum' gets a vertical slot-machine word roll that settles on 'productivity' then on 'performance' (blurred words scroll past), a blue caret bar wipes the line away and reveals 'Experience', then a white circular wipe (~43.5 s) reveals a blurry, over-scaled donut chart that racks into focus with 'A New Era of Productivity' in the centre. A faint line of text above 'Maximum' at 39.0 s is unreadable.
shots.build_rebuild: On a #fff-ish background, animate a centered headline whose second word is a vertical list masked to one line that scrolls (with blur on motion) to the target word, then sweep a blue caret bar across to replace the line, and finish with a circular mask reveal of an SVG donut that scales down from 1.4x to 1x while deblurring.

shots.focal_element: Frosted four-point star shape centred over large blurred gradient blobs, carrying the label 'A New Era of AI'
shots.transition_other: Morph-like change from the donut chart into the glassy star/blob composition (exact transition not visible at 2 fps)
on_screen_text: A New Era of Craft & Quality
shots.typography: Two-line centred lockup: small bold black 'A New Era of' over a larger bold 'AI'; at 47.0 s the same lockup appears in white reading 'A New Era of Craft & Quality'. Geometric sans, title case.
shots.what_happens: On VO 'A.I.' (w77-w78) the frosted star slowly rotates/breathes over soft blue-magenta-orange blobs; the last frame (47.0 s) already shows the next 'era' card: white 'A New Era of Craft & Quality' on the grain gradient, surrounded by 3D phones/UI cards flying outward.
shots.build_rebuild: Layer large blurred gradient ellipses behind a white frosted 4-point star (backdrop-filter blur, soft inner glow), rotate the star ~10deg and scale 1.0-1.05 over 1.5 s, with a centred two-line 'A New Era of / AI' label.
